from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class QuarterlyFinancialMetric(BaseModel):
    """A single quarterly data point of net profit after deducting non-recurring gains/losses from one financial report."""
    company: str | None = Field(description="Name of the company (e.g., 江苏洋河酒厂股份有限公司)")
    report_period: str | None = Field(description="The specific quarter and year the report covers (e.g., 2017年第三季度, 2018年第一季度)")
    metric_name: str | None = Field(description="The exact name of the financial metric")
    current_period_amount: float | None = Field(description="The amount reported for the current quarter/period in yuan")
    current_period_unit: str | None = Field(description="The currency/unit, e.g., '元'")
    previous_period_amount: float | None = Field(description="The comparable amount from the same quarter of the previous year, if available")
    previous_period_year: int | None = Field(description="The year of the previous period amount")
    growth_rate: str | None = Field(description="The reported year-over-year growth rate as a percentage string, e.g., '25.38%'")
    cumulative_amount_ytd: float | None = Field(description="Year-to-date cumulative amount from beginning of year to report end, if available")
    cumulative_growth_rate: str | None = Field(description="Year-to-date growth rate if different from current period growth")
    quote: str = Field(description="A short verbatim excerpt from the report anchoring this data point")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    financial_reports: list[QuarterlyFinancialMetric]
